title: 第21章 军令状第22章 万花盛会
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 楚星河的禁闭提前结束了。
没有人觉得星河师兄被放出来有任何问题，毕竟此次星河师兄可以说是给宗门立了大功啊。
至于大长老提议的让楚星河做领队，宗主二话不说直接点头答应。
一百个名额也很快在各宫被长老们选定出来，能进入这一百个名额的全部都是各宫最优秀的弟子。
药王宫火力全开，所有弟子加紧炼制破石丹为此次灵窟之行做准备。
各项准备都在紧锣密鼓的展开。
万霖也是此次一百个名额之中的一个，她无比欣喜的跑到药王宫这边，刚进门就看到了愁眉不展的楚星河。
星河师兄定然是因为此次成为领队压力巨大，应该是怕无法带领我们拿到更多好处而烦恼吧！
想到这里，万霖心目之中星河师兄的位置又拔高了几分。
“星河师兄！”
万霖上前跟楚星河打招呼。
楚星河抬头看向对方胸前……嗯……很大……不对……是胸前丘林宫的标志，记起来了这个妹子叫万霖！
“万霖师妹你好，有什么困难需要我帮助吗？”
楚星河尽量让自己少看不该看的东西。
“星河师兄，我也是此次百人团之一，本来是特意赶来感谢星河师兄为大家创造了如此机会，可刚才看到星河师兄愁眉不展，想来是因为担心不能带领大家拿到更多的好处而伤神吧。”
万霖一脸崇拜的看着楚星河。
楚星河一边点头一边暗道，我那是担心带着你们拿不到好处么？
我是想着怎么才能把你们全给坑了！
我是因为想不到怎么坑你们才伤神好不好！
“星河师兄放心，虽然我们昊天宗距离最远，但是听长老说我们已经准备了传送阵，不会耽误我们如期赶到地方的，现在距离灵窟的开启时间还有几日，我们来得及，况且所有破石丹都在咱们手里，其他三宗绝无可能提前进入，我们若是到不了，谁也别想进灵窟拿到好处！”
什么玩意儿？
楚星河听到万霖的话整个人愣了三秒！
卧槽，绝世好师妹啊！
此次灵窟之行，楚星河一直在苦恼，到底怎么坑大家呢？
大长老说了，灵窟之中也是有危险的，一个不小心那可是会死人的，所以让楚星河一定要万分小心。
这让楚星河觉得坑大家万一把大家全坑死在那里，心里是真心过不去。
自己是想毁掉昊天宗，不是想屠光昊天宗，这群师兄师妹们一个个可都是好人啊。
所以既要不伤害到大家的性命，还要坑大家，这太难了。
可是万霖的一番话为楚星河打开了另外一条思路。
灵窟的开启是有时间限制的，会在一个特定的时间开启，三宗已经推算出来了，就是五日之后，而一旦错过时间，灵窟就会自动关闭，下次再开启就不知道是猴年马月了。
昊天宗距离灵窟位置最远，虽然有传送阵可以让大家快速赶到，可万事都有个万一吧……
万一赶不到呢？
万一赶不到错过了灵窟开启的时间，那可不光昊天宗，连其他三宗都别想进去，因为破石丹在自己手里。
到时候坑的不光是昊天宗，连那三宗也一块坑了！
要因为昊天宗这边的问题导致其他三宗弟子也无法洗髓伐骨，那三宗能善罢甘休吗！
content_en:
Chu Xinghe's confinement ended early.
No one thinks there is any problem with Senior Brother Xinghe being released. After all, Senior Brother Xinghe can be said to have made great contributions to the sect this time.
As for the great elder's proposal to let Chu Xinghe be the team leader, the sect leader nodded and agreed without saying anything.
One hundred places were quickly selected by the elders in each palace. Those who can enter these one hundred places are all the best disciples in each palace.
The Yaowang Palace was on full fire, and all the disciples stepped up their efforts to refine the stone-breaking pills in preparation for this trip to the spiritual cave.
All preparations are in full swing.
Wan Lin was also one of the one hundred places this time. She ran to Yaowang Palace with great joy. As soon as she entered the door, she saw a frowning Chu Xinghe.
Senior Brother Xinghe must be under great pressure to become the team leader this time, and he must be worried that he will not be able to lead us to get more benefits!
Thinking of this, Wan Lin's position in Senior Brother Xinghe's mind has been raised a bit higher.
"Senior Brother Xinghe!"
Wan Lin stepped forward to greet Chu Xinghe.
Chu Xinghe raised his head and looked at the other person's chest... um... it was very big... no... it was the symbol of Qiulin Palace on the chest, and he remembered that this girl's name was Wan Lin!
"Hello, Junior Sister Wan Lin, do you have any difficulties that you need my help with?"
Chu Xinghe tried his best to avoid seeing as many things as he shouldn't.
"Senior Brother Xinghe, I am also one of the hundred people in this group. I came here specially to thank Brother Xinghe for creating such an opportunity for everyone, but just now I saw Brother Xinghe frowning. I guess it is because I am worried that I will not be able to lead everyone to get more benefits."
Wan Lin looked at Chu Xinghe with admiration.
Chu Xinghe nodded and thought to himself, am I worried that I won't get any benefits from taking you?
I was thinking about how to trick you all!
I'm just upset because I can't think of how to trick you, okay?
"Senior Brother Xinghe, don't worry. Although our Haotian Sect is the farthest away, I heard from the elders that we have prepared the teleportation array, which will not delay our arrival as scheduled. There are still a few days before the opening of the Spiritual Cave, and we can make it in time. Besides, we have all the Stone-Breaking Pills in our hands. It is absolutely impossible for the other three sects to enter in advance. If we cannot arrive, no one will be able to enter the Spiritual Cave and get the benefits!"
What the hell?
When Chu Xinghe heard Wan Lin's words, he was stunned for three seconds!
Damn it, what a peerless junior sister!
During this trip to the spiritual cave, Chu Xinghe has been worrying about how to trick everyone?
The Great Elder said that there are dangers in the spiritual cave, and someone could die if he is not careful, so Chu Xinghe must be extremely careful.
This made Chu Xinghe feel that if he tricked everyone and tricked everyone to death, he really couldn't bear it.
I want to destroy the Haotian Sect, not to massacre the Haotian Sect. These brothers and sisters are all good people.
So it is too difficult to not harm everyone's lives but also to deceive everyone.
But Wan Lin's words opened up another way of thinking for Chu Xinghe.
There is a time limit for the opening of the spiritual cave. It will be opened at a specific time. The three sects have calculated that it will be five days later. Once the time is missed, the spiritual cave will automatically close. The next time it is opened, it will be the Year of the Monkey and the Horse.
Haotian Sect is the furthest away from the Spirit Cave. Although there is a teleportation array that can help everyone get there quickly, there is always a possibility of eventuality...
What if I can't make it?
If you miss the opening time of the Spiritual Cave, not only the Haotian Sect, but also the other three sects will not be able to enter because the Stone-Breaking Pill is in your hand.
By then, not only the Haotian Sect will be tricked, but those three sects will also be tricked!
If the disciples of the other three sects are unable to wash their marrow and cut their bones because of the problems on the Haotian Sect's side, can those three sects just let it go?
